title: Pricing model: the reference product's Black 76 against ours with an implied dividend yield (G-13-4)
reference_behaviour: Greeks come from a modified Black 76 model in which theta, vega and gamma are the same for a call and a put (bundle-findings 2.5 and 7.1).
ours: Black-Scholes-Merton with each expiry's implied dividend yield (ADR-063) for prices, IV, delta, gamma and vega. Theta: was split between call and put by a carry term; measured 2026-11-02 (F-98) the split drifted in 2 minutes and gave gaps up to Rs 209 per lot per day against the reference; owner decided (ADR-234) theta is stated on the forward, the same for a call and a put, like the reference.
